verdict.rationale: SumUp is a payments platform, not an AI agent or assistant host, so consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is a category error for this product type. The MCP evidence shows only the server role: SumUp's managed MCP server and an Agent Toolkit adapter for embedding SumUp tools in your own MCP server. Neither makes the client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
